name: Skullbound Shapechanger
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kitsune race

Benefit(s): The witch receives Realistic Likeness as a bonus feat. If she possesses the skull or face of the individual whom she wishes to transform into using Realistic Likeness, she reduces the bonus on Perception checks that those who are familiar with the individual receive to oppose her Disguise check by half.
